messages.text: Hey team — quick input needed for SURF-142. The siren activation in the mitigation panel is currently buried three levels deep. In a real shark sighting, that's way too slow. Proposing we surface it as a one-tap button on the main panel. Thoughts?

Fully agree. Spoke with Captain Reeves this morning — they've actually had two near-misses where the delay in finding the siren cost critical seconds. One tap is non-negotiable from a safety standpoint.
Design-wise: we should make the button visually distinct (red, full-width) so it can't be missed even under stress. No confirmation modal — we don't want cognitive load in a panic situation.
Agreed on all fronts. I'll add a note to the runbook that the one-press siren path is the canonical evacuation trigger going forward. Old multi-step path stays as a fallback only.
Perfect. Summary: siren must be one tap, top of panel, no confirmation dialog, haptic feedback on mobile. This is the team consensus. Tagging SURF-142.
